task_description: Convert the Aurelix React web app into an Android app using Capacitor. Install Capacitor, configure it for the project, add Android platform, install native plugins (back button, status bar, splash screen, keyboard, camera, push notifications), update Vite config for Capacitor compatibility, and clean up leftover scripts.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds (exit 0, dist/ produced). npm run test passes (1 test file, 1 test passed). npx cap sync succeeds with 7 plugins registered. android/ directory scaffolded with build.gradle. No Docker in this project. Test quality: existing test unchanged, no new tests needed as changes are config/hooks that run only on native platform.
